title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 11: what Yahweh did in Egypt and the wilderness, rain in its season, and the blessing and the curse.

questions.text: What did Yahweh make overflow the army of Egypt as they pursued Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh made the water of the Red Sea overflow the army of Egypt, their horses and their chariots as they pursued Israel.

answers.text: The water of the Red Sea

questions.text: What happened to Dathan and Abiram?
questions.explanation: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents and every living thing that followed them.

answers.text: Fire came down and burned them
The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them
They were sent out of the camp

questions.text: How was seed watered in the land of Egypt, according to Deuteronomy 11:10?
questions.explanation: In Egypt they sowed their seed and watered it with their foot, as a garden of herbs. The new land drinks water from the rain of the sky.

answers.text: By the rain of the sky
With the foot, as a garden of herbs
By the dew of heaven above

questions.text: What does Deuteronomy 11:12 say about Yahweh's eyes and the land?
questions.explanation: It is a land Yahweh cares for; his eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year to the end of the year.

answers.text: They are on it only at harvest time
They are turned toward Egypt instead
They are on it only on the Sabbath
They are always on it, all year long

questions.text: Which rain does Yahweh promise to give in its season?
questions.explanation: If they listen and love him, he will give the rain in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, so they can gather grain, wine and oil.

answers.text: The early rain and the latter rain
Rain once a year at harvest

questions.text: If they turn away to serve other gods, what will Yahweh do with the sky?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's anger would be kindled and he would shut up the sky so that there is no rain and the land does not yield its fruit.

answers.text: Make it rain fire on the land
Send great hail on the fields
Shut it up so there is no rain

questions.text: Which river is named as a border in Deuteronomy 11:24?
questions.explanation: Their border would run from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, to the western sea.

questions.text: What two things does Moses set before Israel in Deuteronomy 11:26?
questions.explanation: Moses says: "Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse."

questions.text: On which mountain were they to set the blessing?
questions.explanation: When they come into the land, they are to set the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

questions.text: Beside what are Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal, according to Deuteronomy 11:30?
questions.explanation: They are beyond the Jordan, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh.
